border_line.description: One edge of a cell border.

style.description: Line style. `None` = no line. Drawn widths in pixels at 100%: Hair, Thin, Dashed, Dotted, DashDot, DashDotDot = 1; Medium, MediumDashed, MediumDashDot, MediumDashDotDot, SlantDashDot = 2; Thick, Double = 3.

cell_format.description: The complete format of a cell: font, fill, borders, alignment, number format, protection. Every part is always present (a default format spells out the defaults).

h.description: Horizontal. `General` = numbers right, text left, booleans and errors centred.

indent.description: Indent level, 0..255 (one level is about three spaces).

rotation.description: Text rotation in degrees counter-clockwise, -90..90; the special value 255 means vertically stacked letters.

shrink.description: Shrink the text to fit the cell width.

wrap.description: Wrap text onto several lines within the cell.

fg.description: Pattern foreground; THE fill colour when the pattern is `Solid`.

pattern.description: `None` = no fill. `Solid` = filled with `fg`. Every other value is a two-colour pattern drawn in `fg` over `bg` (the ECMA-376 pattern types, e.g. Gray125 = 12.5% dots).

name.description: Typeface family name, e.g. `Calibri`. Only a name: no font file is referenced or embedded, and a reader substitutes an available face. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader shows or stores it and never resolves it as a path or address.

underline.description: Underline. The Accounting kinds sit lower, below descenders.

num_fmt.description: Number format code in the spreadsheet format-code language (ECMA-376 Part 1, 18.8.31), written with `.` as the decimal point and `,` as the thousands separator, e.g. `General`, `0.00`, `#,##0.00`, `yyyy-mm-dd`, `0.0%`, `@`. It decides how a number is DISPLAYED, including whether a number is shown as a date; it never changes the stored value. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader shows or stores it and never resolves it as a path or address.

protection.description: What sheet protection does to the cell (only while the sheet is protected).

hidden.description: The cell's formula is not shown. Default false.

locked.description: The cell cannot be edited. Default true.

cell_ref.description: One cell of the grid, by ZERO-BASED row and column: the cell written `A1` is {"row": 0, "col": 0}, `C7` is {"row": 6, "col": 2}.

col.description: Zero-based column index, 0..16383 (the grid has 16,384 columns; column 0 is `A`, 25 is `Z`, 26 is `AA`).

row.description: Zero-based row index, 0..1048575 (the grid has 1,048,576 rows).

color.description: A colour: automatic, an explicit RGB value, or a slot of the workbook theme with a tint.

oneOf.description: Automatic: black for text and lines, no fill for fills.

Rgb.description: 0xRRGGBB packed in one integer: red*65536 + green*256 + blue, each component 0..255, sRGB.

oneOf.description: A theme colour with a tint.

Theme.description: [slot, tint]. slot: index 0..255 into `theme.colors` of the styles node (0 = light 1 / background, 1 = dark 1 / text, 2 = light 2, 3 = dark 2, 4..9 = accent 1..6, 10 = hyperlink, 11 = followed hyperlink; a slot beyond 11 resolves to black). tint: -1000..1000 thousandths; 0 = the theme colour itself. To resolve: convert the theme colour to HSL; if tint < 0 then L' = L * (1 + tint/1000), else L' = L * (1 - tint/1000) + tint/1000; convert back to RGB.

range_ref.description: A rectangle of cells, both corners INCLUDED. `start` is the top-left corner and `end` the bottom-right one (start.row <= end.row and start.col <= end.col; a reader that finds them swapped swaps them back). A whole row spans columns 0..16383; a whole column spans rows 0..1048575.

description: The formats of a spreadsheet/1 document (node type core.sheet.styles, node_id `styles`).

cell_formats.description: The cell formats. A cell's `style` number (in the cells binary), and the `style` of a row or column record, is the ZERO-BASED index into this array. Entry 0 is the default format. The array only ever grows: an index, once written, keeps its meaning in every later revision of the same document. A style number beyond the end of the array means entry 0.

named_styles.description: Named cell styles (a styles gallery): a name and the format it stands for. Cells do not refer to them.

name.description: The style's name. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader shows or stores it and never resolves it as a path or address.

schema_version.description: Revision of this payload's schema. Always 1 in profile spreadsheet/1.

colors.description: The twelve theme colours, each 0xRRGGBB packed as red*65536 + green*256 + blue (sRGB), in this order: light 1, dark 1, light 2, dark 2, accent 1..6, hyperlink, followed hyperlink. A `Theme` colour's slot indexes this array.

major_font.description: Heading typeface family name. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader shows or stores it and never resolves it as a path or address.

minor_font.description: Body typeface family name. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader shows or stores it and never resolves it as a path or address.

name.description: Theme name. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader shows or stores it and never resolves it as a path or address.

title: core.sheet.styles - cell formats, named styles and theme
